title: Workbooks — full-throttle roadmap
subtitle: Architecture is settled. Now: prove it functions, dogfood the core, ship the surfaces. Agents mark tasks off; this page hot-reloads.
mantra: dogfood · dogfood · dogfood — we build the same things we want others to build, composably and well.
